seo.title: Macro Easy — Protein, Carbs and Fat Tracker for iPhone
seo.description: Log protein, carbs and fat in one line, like “Chicken salad 35p 10c 12f”, and see what’s left to eat today. USDA food search, Apple Health, widgets. No account.

hero.label: MACRO TRACKER
hero.title: Log a meal in one line.
text: Type “Chicken salad 35p 10c 12f” and it’s logged. Macro Easy shows what’s left of today’s protein, carbs and fat, and a flag lights up as you reach each target. Ink on paper, with color only where it means something.

items.title: Type It Once
items.text: Write a meal the way you'd say it: “Chicken salad 35p 10c 12f”. Macro Easy reads the name and the grams on your iPhone and shows a card to check before anything is logged.

items.title: Know What's Left
items.text: Today leads with what matters, like “75 g protein to go”. Protein, carbs and fat sit against your daily targets, and a flag lights up as you reach each one.

items.title: Saved Meals
items.text: Save the meals you eat often. They sit on Today, in the menu and in search, ready to log again in two taps.

items.title: USDA Food Search
items.text: Look up a food in USDA FoodData Central, pick a serving or type the grams, and Macro Easy works out the macros for that amount.

items.title: History
items.text: Calories per day against your target, your averages, and how often you met your protein target. Open any day to fix a meal or add one you forgot.

items.title: Apple Health, Widgets and Siri
items.text: Turn on Apple Health and every meal is saved there too. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show today at a glance, and Siri can log a meal for you.

items.title: Your Targets
items.text: Set the grams of protein, carbs and fat you aim for. Calories add up from them on their own.

items.title: Your Accent
items.text: Pick one of eight accents for the flags. It sets the app icon too, with dark and tinted versions, and the widget.

items.title: Day or Night
items.text: Follow your iPhone or pick Light or Dark. After dark, choose soft Graphite or true OLED Black.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your meals stay yours.
text: No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Your meals stay on your iPhone. Food search sends only the words you type to USDA FoodData Central, and Apple Health gets your meals only if you turn it on.
